entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that operates in N1 mode capability.

entities.name: N1 mode capability
entities.description: The capability of the UE to operate in N1 mode.

entities.name: UE powers off and powers on again
entities.description: Condition where the UE is turned off and then turned back on.

entities.name: USIM is removed
entities.description: Condition where the USIM card is physically removed from the UE.

entities.name: Entry of the list of subscriber data with SNPN identity updated
entities.description: Condition where an entry in the list of subscriber data containing the SNPN identity is updated.

relations.description: UE powering off and on again triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
Removal of USIM triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
Update of SNPN identity entry in list of subscriber data triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
UE is defined to have N1 mode capability.
